def out_rule(g, mode='eq'):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])

    d=max([j for j in range(w) if len(set(g[i][j] for i in range(h)))==1 and g[0][j]!=bg])
    L=[[r[j] for j in range(d)] for r in g]
    R=[[r[d+1+j] for j in range(w-d-1)] for r in g]
